item.title: USDA offering disaster assistance to Arkansas farmers impacted by winter storms
item.description: The USDA is offering technical and financial assistance to Arkansas farmers and livestock producers impacted by winter storms, including the Livestock Indemnity Program, Noninsured Crop Disaster Assistance Program, and loan guarantees.
